race.title: Campbell & Haughey Solicitors Nursery Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: This looks an excellent opportunity for INVINCIBLE IRISH who brings easily the most solid profile to the table and he'll find this much less demanding than the assignment he faced when third over 5f here last week. Scarlet Dream and nursery debutant Mirissa Beach may offer chief resistance. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE) SCARLET DREAM (IRE) MIRISSA BEACH (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Invincible Irish (11/8), Tina Tereshkova (5/2), Scarlet Dream (7/1), Stellar Path (8/1), Sorrento Sunset (10/1), Mirissa Beach (16/1), No Time Faults (25/1), Chiquitita Bee (33/1)
